accounts.name: stake_airdrop
docs: Graduated + airdrop path (omit / pass none on Failed).

accounts.name: source_story
docs: Forfeited story whose vault SOL feeds the winner.

accounts.name: dest_story
docs: Winner (or soon-to-graduate Active) narrative receiving the losing pool.

accounts.name: ranking_board
docs: King-of-the-Hill rank slots (1..=5). Lazy-init on first graduate.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Story SOL vault — seed (principal + 80% losing) moves to curve; bonus stays.

accounts.name: stake_airdrop
docs: Staker airdrop escrow metadata (created at graduate).

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: New SPL mint for VelocityCurve::initialize_token (must sign; created in CPI).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Crank / payer for RankingBoard init and CPI rent.

accounts.name: stake_position
docs: The stake being marked claimable in this crank call.

accounts.name: user_stake_index
docs: Required so Forfeited positions can free a UserStakeIndex slot (no claim path).

accounts.name: vault
docs: Story SOL vault PDA.

accounts.name: user_stake_index
docs: Global per-user open-stake counter. Seeds = ["user-stakes", staker].

accounts.name: config
docs: (staker_airdrop_bps / post_threshold_secs appended). Realloc'd in handler.

errors.name: ThresholdMet
errors.msg: Cannot fail: graduation threshold is met (graduate or forfeit instead)

errors.name: InvalidRank
errors.msg: Rank must be 0 (auto) or 1–5 for graduation

errors.name: RankTaken
errors.msg: Rank slot already occupied by another story

errors.name: AlreadyResolved
errors.msg: Story already resolved (Graduated, Failed, or Forfeited)

errors.name: NotForfeited
errors.msg: Story must be Forfeited to contribute losing stakes

errors.name: InvalidContributeDest
errors.msg: Destination must be Active or Graduated to receive losing pool

errors.name: InsufficientVault
errors.msg: Vault has insufficient lamports (rent / liquidity reserve)

errors.name: InvalidContributeAmount
errors.msg: Contribute amount is zero or exceeds available

errors.name: MaxStakesExceeded
errors.msg: User has reached max_stakes_per_user open story stakes

errors.name: AirdropAlreadyInitialized
errors.msg: Stake airdrop already initialized for this story

types.name: AirdropClaim
docs: Per-staker receipt that token airdrop share was claimed.
Seeds = [b"airdrop-claim", story, staker]

fields.name: amount
docs: Raw token units transferred to the staker.

types.name: MarketPhase
docs: Lifecycle of a StoryMarket.

types.name: NarrativeConfig
docs: Global config PDA: seeds = [b"narrative-config"]

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Protocol fee on each stake. 200 = 2%.

fields.name: graduation_window
docs: Default auction duration in seconds (24–48h).

fields.name: curve_program
docs: VelocityCurve program id for graduation CPI.

fields.name: staker_airdrop_bps
docs: Share of notional 1B supply reserved for staker airdrop at graduate (bps).
Default 2000 = 20%. Tunable via update_config. Max 5000 (50%).
Appended after bump so existing Devnet configs deserialize (prefix-compatible);
realloc + zero-fill yields 0 → update_config applies default.

fields.name: post_threshold_secs
docs: Final auction window after graduation threshold is met (seconds).
Default 1800 = 30 minutes. When total_staked crosses the threshold,
`ends_at` is clamped to `min(ends_at, now + post_threshold_secs)`.
Never extends a shorter auction (Devnet 60s smoke stays short).
Appended after staker_airdrop_bps (prefix-compatible); 0 → default on migrate.

fields.name: ends_at
docs: Current auction end (may be clamped when threshold is met).

types.name: RankingBoard
docs: Singleton King-of-the-Hill board: which stories occupy ranks 1..=5.
Seeds = [b"ranking-board"]

fields.name: ranks
docs: Story pubkeys for ranks 1..=5 (`Pubkey::default()` = empty slot).

types.name: StakeAirdrop
docs: Escrow metadata for the staker token airdrop at graduation.
Seeds = [b"stake-airdrop", story]
Token vault = ATA(mint, this PDA). Separate from StoryMarket so existing
story accounts keep their layout after program upgrade.

fields.name: total_amount
docs: Total raw token units reserved for stakers.

fields.name: claimed_amount
docs: Raw units already transferred out via claim_stake.

fields.name: bps
docs: Snapshot of config.staker_airdrop_bps at graduate.

types.name: StakePosition
docs: Per-user stake on a story.
Seeds = [b"stake", story, staker]

fields.name: amount
docs: Net amount credited after fee (lamports).

fields.name: accuracy_score
docs: Updated post-resolution (0–10000 bps accuracy).

fields.name: claimable
docs: Claimable lamports after resolve: Graduated = bonus only; Failed = principal.

fields.name: is_winner
docs: True if this stake is on a Graduated narrative.

fields.name: resolved
docs: True once resolve_stakes has set claimable (even if 0 for Forfeited).

types.name: StoryMarket
docs: One narrative / story market.
Seeds = [b"story", creator, content_hash]

fields.name: content_hash
docs: IPFS / content-addressed hash of the narrative JSON.

fields.name: total_staked
docs: Net SOL credited to this narrative after fees (lamports).

fields.name: graduation_threshold
docs: Minimum total_staked required to graduate.

fields.name: winning_pool
docs: Accumulated losing-stake SOL attributed to this winner (pre-split).

fields.name: rank
docs: Rank assigned at graduation (1..=5). 0 = unranked.

fields.name: liquidity_reserve
docs: Transient: 80% of winning_pool at graduate; zeroed after seed transfer to curve.
Curve seed also includes `total_staked` (staker principal buy).

fields.name: winner_bonus_pool
docs: SOL reserved for proportional winner bonus payouts (20% of winning_pool).
Principal is NOT reclaimable on Graduated — it seeded the curve.

fields.name: contributed_out
docs: Lamports already transferred out of this vault via contribute (Forfeited).

fields.name: claimed_total
docs: Lamports paid out via claim_stake (vault accounting).

types.name: UserStakeIndex
docs: Per-user index of distinct open story stakes.
Seeds = [b"user-stakes", user]
Enforces `NarrativeConfig.max_stakes_per_user` (default 20): counts how many
distinct stories the user currently has an open StakePosition on. Incremented
when a new position is opened; decremented on claim (Graduated/Failed) or on
resolve when Forfeited (claimable = 0, lifecycle ends without claim).

fields.name: active_stakes
docs: Distinct stories with an open (not yet closed) stake.

fields.name: delta
docs: +1 on open, -1 on close (claim / forfeited resolve).
